title: The AI Power Bill: Who Gets Grid Capacity, and Who Bears the Risk?
content: As electricity access becomes a financial barrier to AI expansion, the U.S. and China face different risks in building the infrastructure of the digital economy. The post The AI Power Bill: Who Gets Grid Capacity, and Who Bears the Risk? appeared first on EE Times .

title: Craig Cowden named CEO of TierPoint
content: Cable and mobile industry vet Craig Cowden has been named CEO of cloud and data center specialist TierPoint. He'll succeed founding CEO Jerry Kent on January 4, 2027. #pressrelease

title: The GPU gold rush creates a CPU opportunity — and Akamai knows it
content: Akamai COO Adam Karon says AI agents will shift work from GPUs to CPUs at the network edge, opening a market for CPU makers and networking firms.
